components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default directional action on light fields.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 52px; padding: .95rem 1.35rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; color: #fff; background: var(--ink, #171522); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(23,21,34,.18); font: 600 1rem/1 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary span { transition: transform 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:hover span { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--coral, #ff715b); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A secondary exploratory action that keeps the warm field visible.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 52px; padding: .95rem 1.35rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #171522); border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink, #171522); background: transparent; font: 600 1rem/1 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline span { transition: transform 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-outline:hover span { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--coral, #ff715b); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin: 0 0 .5rem; color: var(--ink, #171522); font: 600 .82rem/1.3 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 .9rem; border: 1px solid rgba(23,21,34,.16); border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink, #171522); background: #fff; caret-color: var(--violet, #5a32e5); font: 400 1rem/1.4 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: rgba(23,21,34,.35); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--coral, #ff715b); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-field[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: #b52f24; }

components.name: Masthead Navigation
components.description: Compact semibold anchors with a directional violet underline.
components.html: TracksJourneyBuildsTeams
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 2rem; color: var(--ink, #171522); font: 600 .9rem/1.2 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: -8px; left: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--violet, #5a32e5); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; transition: transform 220ms ease; } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--coral, #ff715b); outline-offset: 6px; }

components.css: .ds-project-card { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(23,21,34,.16); border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink, #171522); background: var(--paper, #fffdf6); font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-project-visual { position: relative; min-height: 170px; overflow: hidden; background: #e8e3f2; } .ds-project-visual i { position: absolute; top: 18%; left: 18%; width: 44%; height: 58%; background: var(--violet, #5a32e5); clip-path: polygon(0 0,100% 20%,68% 100%,12% 77%); transform: rotate(24deg); } .ds-project-visual b { position: absolute; top: 15%; right: 16%; width: 22%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--coral, #ff715b); box-shadow: 0 0 0 18px rgba(255,255,255,.45); } .ds-project-copy { padding: 1.7rem; } .ds-project-copy p { margin: 0 0 1rem; color: var(--violet, #5a32e5); font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-project-copy h3 { margin: 0 0 1rem; font: 600 2.3rem/.95 'Syne', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.05em; } .ds-project-copy span { color: #655f6d; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Track Selector
components.description: A ruled selector whose active row becomes the current signal source.
components.css: .ds-track { width: 100%; min-height: 86px; padding: 1rem 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 44px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(23,21,34,.16); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(23,21,34,.16); color: var(--ink, #171522); background: transparent; text-align: left; font: 400 1.25rem/1.2 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-track span { width: 2rem; height: 2rem; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-track strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-track b { font-weight: 400; transition: transform 240ms ease; } .ds-track:hover b, .ds-track[aria-pressed='true'] b { transform: translateX(5px); } .ds-track[aria-pressed='true'] { color: var(--violet, #5a32e5); } .ds-track:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--coral, #ff715b); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
Hackthon feels like an optimistic future lab assembled from paper, ink, and live electrical signals. The visual system makes the event's process visible: challenges enter, planes shift, teams form, and prototypes emerge. Its energy comes from the tension between an editorial foundation and vivid technical instrumentation, never from a conventional startup hero or a generic feature-card grid.

The system is spacious without becoming passive. Oversized, tightly set headlines create momentum; hairlines, labels, index marks, and structured rails keep that energy precise. Interaction changes the composition itself—signal colors switch, geometry recalibrates, progress advances—so state always feels causal and legible.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ivory and paper surfaces grounded by dense near-black ink.
Ultraviolet structural planes with coral and electric-lime signals.
Oversized Syne headlines paired with calm, readable DM Sans copy.
Square paper-like panels, circular instruments, and asymmetric clipped geometry.
Motion that settles like calibrated machinery and fully yields to reduced-motion preferences.

rules.name: The Signal Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Coral and lime indicate focus, progress, availability, or a meaningful visual event; they are not general-purpose decoration.

rules.name: The Warm Field Rule
rules.body: Default pages sit on warm ivory, while paper white is reserved for distinct sheets and controls.

rules.name: The Compression Creates Energy Rule
rules.body: Display type earns its scale through short copy, tight tracking, and constrained line length; do not apply the same compression to body text.

rules.name: The Unequal Pair Rule
rules.body: When two regions share a row, give one clear visual authority; avoid defaulting to symmetrical halves unless the content genuinely demands parity.

rules.name: The Flat Until Active Rule
rules.body: Ordinary content surfaces stay flat; ambient lift appears on interactive, selected, or modal layers.

rules.name: The Instruments Are Round Rule
rules.body: Use circles for status, identity, sequence, and reactor mechanics; do not soften rectangular containers into generic rounded cards.

rules.name: The Cut Is Intentional Rule
rules.body: Polygonal clipping belongs to expressive reactor and project imagery, not functional text containers.

dos: Do use warm ivory as the default canvas and reserve paper white for distinct sheets.
Do pair one dominant proposition with one supporting explanation in each section.
Do use hairlines, labels, indices, and rails to make process and state visible.
Do connect interactive state to more than color when possible through arrows, geometry, halos, or progress.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and disable nonessential motion for reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't turn the system into a conventional startup hero followed by a uniform feature-card grid.
Don't round buttons, fields, cards, or primary panels into soft generic capsules.
Don't use coral or lime without a signal, status, focus, or progress role.
Don't compress body typography to imitate the display face.
Don't add decorative shadows to every surface; flatness is the default.
